description: OPEN-04 route-aware companion and scenario-family policy: aggregate reserve-balance incidence of the modeled Treasury events. Foreign holders settle through US banks because the scenarios model no non-Treasury dollar inflows that could sustain foreign official purchases from Federal Reserve accounts. Money-fund route flows settle through bank accounts because money funds held essentially no ON RRP at the opening.

mmf_cash_fund_route.source: FRED RRPONTSYD: total ON RRP accepted was 0.251 billion dollars on 2026-06-18, the last operation before the 2026-06-21 opening; money funds held essentially no ON RRP balance from which to fund purchases or in which to place receipts

opening_balance_sources.ONRRP_MMF: FRED RRPONTSYD total ON RRP accepted on 2026-06-18, the last operation before the 2026-06-21 opening; an upper bound on the money-fund balance
